metadata.author: Scott Sun
metadata.principle: Platform attention is reported separately from scientific validation.

candidate.name: Sun's (2,4,6,8) Conjecture
candidate.description: The V23.4 phase completed an exhaustive computational investigation of the candidate n* = 896,315,812,331,399 within the mathematically bounded search domain. The computation examined 2,818,953,028 admissible (z,y,x) triples using exact integer arithmetic and found no representation of the candidate.

archive.description: Historical GitHub traffic is not currently archived in this JSON file. GitHub traffic is limited to the platform's rolling 14-day window.

publications.title: A Computational Audit of a Candidate Counterexample to Sun's (2,4,6,8) Conjecture: Exhaustive Verification and Cantor-Pascal Diagnostics

records.title: A Computational Audit of a Candidate Counterexample to Sun's (2,4,6,8) Conjecture: Exhaustive Verification and Cantor-Pascal Diagnostics

reach_events.definition: Platform-level access events reported by the respective platforms.
reach_events.formula: GitHub views + ResearchGate reads + Zenodo views + OSF views
reach_events.interpretation: Observable platform events. They are not equivalent to unique researchers.

engagement_events.definition: Observable interaction signals beyond passive access.
engagement_events.interpretation: An event-based engagement indicator. It is not a deduplicated count of individuals.

research_action_events.definition: Observable actions suggesting activity beyond passive viewing.
research_action_events.formula: GitHub clones + GitHub forks + Zenodo downloads + OSF downloads
research_action_events.interpretation: These actions indicate research-related activity but do not constitute independent scientific verification.

validation_events.definition: Externally documented evidence providing stronger confirmation of the research claim.
validation_events.interpretation: Only independently documented validation events are included.

deduplication.description: Cross-platform users cannot currently be deduplicated. Platform events are therefore reported separately rather than converted into estimated unique individuals.

github_traffic.description: GitHub traffic represents the platform's currently available rolling traffic window and should not be interpreted as lifetime traffic.

checks: No platform attention metric is classified as scientific validation.
